question: How many prints by Rembrandt are there?
Which Rembrandt prints are held by four museums?
reference: SELECT ?title WHERE { ?print a mc:Print ; mc:artist <https://aprigge.github.io/museum-crosswalk/id/person/Q5598> ; dcterms:title ?title . ?w mc:impressionOf ?print ; mc:museum ?m } GROUP BY ?print ?title HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) = 4)

question: How many impressions of the Hundred Guilder Print does each museum hold?
reference: SELECT ?museum (COUNT(DISTINCT ?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?print a mc:Print ; mc:bartsch 74 . ?w mc:impressionOf ?print ; mc:museum ?museum } GROUP BY ?museum

question: Which museums have paintings by Rembrandt, and how many each?
reference: SELECT ?museum (COUNT(DISTINCT ?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w mc:artist <https://aprigge.github.io/museum-crosswalk/id/person/Q5598> ; mc:objectType "painting" ; mc:museum ?museum } GROUP BY ?museum

question: Which Rembrandt drawings does the Met have?
In which decade did Rembrandt begin the most prints?
reference: SELECT ?decade WHERE { ?w mc:artist <https://aprigge.github.io/museum-crosswalk/id/person/Q5598> ; mc:objectType "print" ; mc:beginYear ?y . BIND(FLOOR(?y / 10) * 10 AS ?decade) } GROUP BY ?decade ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(DISTINCT ?w)) LIMIT 1

question: How many Rembrandt prints have impressions in only one museum?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT ?print WHERE { ?print a mc:Print ; mc:artist <https://aprigge.github.io/museum-crosswalk/id/person/Q5598> . ?w mc:impressionOf ?print ; mc:museum ?m } GROUP BY ?print HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) = 1) } }
